demo.desc: Layout by Yoga, drawing by ImGui's ImDrawList; the view layer never touches a graphics API.

json.hint: This page comes from resources/views/*.json: attribute tables are per-class static, values accept native types and "12px" / "50%" / "@i18n/" / "@style/" / "@theme/" / "@res/" prefixes. List items are the same idea, with values supplied by a binder.
json.list_section: List item template from JSON + data binding
json.load_failed: JSON failed to load, see the log window
json.card_desc: Text, spacing, radius and colors all live in JSON; copy changes need no rebuild.
json.row_subtitle: fields title / subtitle / thumb come from a C++ binder

theme.hint: Appearance comes from resources/theme/<name>/widgets/*.json: draw structure (background/border/text) and state animation (tweeny interpolation) all live in JSON. Copy default, rename, edit JSON - that is a new skin.
theme.widgets_desc: Rectangle and Button contain no drawing code at all - background, radius, text and colors all come from JSON.
theme.states_desc: Move focus with left/right, watch the color tween; press A to see the press feedback.
